benefit.name: Grande Prairie AISH Transit Pass & Recreation Access
benefit.summary: If you're on AISH, a monthly Grande Prairie transit pass costs $10.25 instead of $74.25. This is the deepest municipal transit discount in the province that we've found.
benefit.note: Important: AISH and ADAP recipients are not part of the general Transit Access Program. You get your own, cheaper pass instead ($10.25 vs $37.13). Ask for the AISH pass by name at City Hall.
benefit.applyText: Open the official page on cityofgp.com

detail.about: Grande Prairie prices a monthly transit SUPERPASS at $10.25 for AISH recipients, against $74.25 at the regular adult rate. It's separate from the city's general low-income Transit Access Program, which AISH recipients are explicitly excluded from — because this is the better deal. The Recreation Access Program is a separate application giving 75% off memberships, punch passes and registered programs.

aboutList.lead: Grande Prairie prices a monthly transit SUPERPASS at $10.25 for AISH recipients, against $74.25 at the regular adult rate.
items: It's separate from the city's general low-income Transit Access Program, which AISH recipients are explicitly excluded from — because this is the better deal.
The Recreation Access Program is a separate application giving 75% off memberships, punch passes and registered programs.

steps: For the transit pass: go to City Hall (10205 98 Street) and ask for the AISH monthly pass — bring your AISH documentation.
For recreation: apply separately to the Recreation Access Program, online or in person.
In-person applications are approved on the spot — about 10 minutes. Online takes about 2 days.
documents: Proof of a Grande Prairie address
For recreation: household income and any dependent children's details
tips: Don't let anyone put you in the Transit Access Program instead. It is a 50% discount ($37.13), and the AISH pass is $10.25. Say 'AISH pass' clearly.
The Recreation Access Program uses a higher income line than most (the low-income cut-off plus 30%). Apply even if you've been refused elsewhere.
detail.time: Same day in person; about 2 days online.
